code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    mid = n // 2
    out = [[7 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    color = grid[mid][mid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n)
             if grid[r][c] == color and (r != mid or c != mid)]
    top = sum(r < mid for r, c in cells) >= sum(r > mid for r, c in cells)
    left = sum(c < mid for r, c in cells) >= sum(c > mid for r, c in cells)
    for k in range(mid + 1):
        if top and left:
            out[k][k] = color
        elif top:
            out[k][n - 1 - k] = color
        elif left:
            out[n - 1 - k][k] = color
        else:
            out[n - 1 - k][n - 1 - k] = color
    return out
'''
